ValidationRule.description: Not allow changing No of Pax after Case Status "Waiting for Payment"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
And(
Or(ischanged( No_of_Adult__c ), ischanged( No_of_Child__c ), ISCHANGED(No_of_Infant__c), ischanged( No_of_FOC__c ) ),
Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "New", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Ticket Sales in Progress", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Request for Ticketing", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Price Approving", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Adhoc Request Approved"
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Not allow changing No. of Pax after the Case Status "Waiting for Payment"
